title: Construction of YM4 with an infrared cutoff
scope_note: Pure SU(2), four dimensions, trivial topological sector, fixed infrared cutoff, regularized axial gauge. Authors state existence of an ultraviolet limit of Schwinger functions and cutoff-adapted Slavnov identities. Printed pp.326-327 explicitly characterize convergence arguments as a detailed outline rather than a full self-contained proof; p.378 calls the argument a sketch of proof. They do not remove the infrared cutoff, investigate large gauge transformations/nontrivial topology, construct renormalized gauge-invariant composite observables, or establish the complete Osterwalder-Schrader axioms. Reflection positivity is proposed as additional work. These are precise scope limits of this source, not a judgment on repository results.
